record.title: ChIPmentation: fast, robust, low-input ChIP-seq for histones and transcription factors.
record.scope: Cells/chromatin through antibody-directed enrichment, tagmentation, library preparation, sequencing and enrichment interpretation; keep histone/transcription-factor alternatives explicit.

operations.name: On-bead tagmentation, version 1
operations.action: Wash the LiCl-washed enriched beads twice with 10 mM cold Tris-Cl pH 8.0 to remove detergents, salts and EDTA. Carefully resuspend in 30 μl tagmentation reaction with 1 μl Nextera Tagment DNA Enzyme; incubate 10 minutes at 37°C in a thermocycler. Perform this on enriched bead-bound chromatin before elution or crosslink reversal.

unresolved.description: Matched IgG ChIPmentation controls and their background role are reported, but the inspected original Methods/Supplementary Note and author protocol do not assign their ChIP version, IgG species/dose, experimental matching rule, or how control replicates were pooled for merged peak calling. The record preserves a demonstrated preparation boundary and uses only the documented matched-background role. This is nonblocking for the frozen general workflow boundary; it prevents an exact control recipe or historical background assignment from being claimed.
unresolved.next_evidence: Obtain the original IgG-specific ChIPmentation preparation and target/control matching instructions, including the control input amount, antibody identity/dose, selected ChIP version and control-replicate combination for merged calls.

unresolved.description: The ChIPmentation amplification Methods explicitly gives the analytical qPCR thermal program, KAPA preactivation, production reaction composition and N = ceil(Cq) rule, but does not independently label a complete production thermal waveform. The cited ATAC protocol uses a different NEBnext recipe and preamplification/extension scheme; that scheme is not asserted for ChIPmentation. This is a noncritical internal recipe gap for the declared library-enrichment boundary, not a missing material transformation.
unresolved.next_evidence: Original ChIPmentation production-PCR cycling instructions specifying initial nick translation/denaturation, per-cycle extension and final extension, with explicit assignment to the 50 μl KAPA production reaction.

unresolved.description: The original rule is to ensure consistency before merged biological-replicate peak analysis, and the paper specifies ranked peak-overlap comparisons, but it does not supply a numerical consistency acceptance threshold or a deterministic decision algorithm. The reported qualitative prerequisite is retained. Nonblocking for the described general decision boundary; no numerical replication claim is made.
unresolved.next_evidence: A source defining the authors’ replicate-consistency acceptance criterion and how the overlap measures determine whether merged analysis proceeds.

unresolved.description: The Methods reports ChIPmentation start offsets (+4/−5 bp), normalized tracks and MACS2 peak calling, but the exact shifted/unshifted coordinate/file representation given to MACS2 is not stated in these passages. The record retains the processed-read-to-peak-calling boundary without asserting an exact handoff representation. Nonblocking for this source-described general workflow; it limits exact numerical peak reconstruction.
unresolved.next_evidence: Original analysis commands or a primary description identifying the MACS2 input representation and where the +4/−5 adjustment is applied relative to calling.

unresolved.description: The original sources report simultaneous fragmentation and adapter tagging on bead-bound chromatin and name Nextera Tagment DNA Enzyme. The cited ATAC oligo table provides PCR primer designs; it does not establish the exact loaded Nextera transposase adapter duplex, fragment-end covalent structure or complete nick-repair intermediate for this ChIPmentation reaction. The record states the supported tagging boundary and reported nick translation without inventing those molecular internals. Noncritical detail gap for this general published variant; experimental replacement of the commercial reagent is not established.
unresolved.next_evidence: A source specific to the original Nextera Tagment DNA Enzyme used here that identifies the loaded adapter strands, transposase-to-DNA product structure and how the reported first-PCR nick translation resolves the intermediate.

record.title: Drop-seq: original 2015 general single-cell droplet RNA capture assay
record.scope: General original Macosko et al. 2015 Drop-seq assay: preparation of required barcoded beads and co-flow device, intact single-cell suspension interface, cell/bead droplet partitioning and lysis/poly(A) RNA capture, bead recovery, bulk reverse transcription/template switching, unextended-primer removal, cDNA amplification, 3-prime sequencing-library formation and paired readout/decoding to cell-associated gene molecule counts. Retain original bead/primer variants and source-reported choices/unknowns. Exclude exact historical retina/cohort recreation, cell culture/animal details as universal requirements, clustering and biological discovery, later assay variants, and unqualified transfer of optimized online-protocol recipes. Original full paper and original supplementary information are authoritative; binary originals and figure layouts remain available beside registered text renditions. The registered Illumina manufacturer source is Part 15031942 Rev.D (September 2014), selected faithful scan transcriptions for the delegated Nextera XT mechanism/tagmentation/neutralization and cleanup context. The exact historical guide revision is not stated by the paper. Applicability must be justified; general guide input, PCR, indexing, elution, normalization and instrument defaults do not override the original paper/supplement modifications.

operations.name: Fragment cDNA and add Nextera adapters
operations.action: Tagment each original 600-pg cDNA aliquot using standard Nextera XT as delegated by the supplement. The contemporaneous Rev.D guide explains simultaneous fragmentation/adapter-end addition and gives TD 10 uL, ATM 5 uL, heated-lid 55 C 5 min then 10 C hold. These are explicitly manufacturer-context conditions for the delegated operation, not proof of the historical guide revision. Its 5-uL, 1-ng DNA default does not replace the paper's 600-pg mass; actual original DNA volume remains unknown.

Delegated-step Rev.D context: 55 C 5 min with heated lid, hold 10 C and proceed immediately to neutralization because transposome remains active. Four physical aliquots of 600 pg amplified cDNA enter four Nextera XT reactions; manufacturer 1-ng default does not override this.

evidence.quote: 9 Place the NTA plate in a thermal cycler and run the following program: NOTE Make sure that the thermal cycler lid is heated during the incubation. • 55°C for 5 minutes • Hold at 10°C. 10 When the sample reaches 10°C, proceed immediately to Neutralize NTA as the transposome is still active.
evidence.rationale: Supports resource at its stated applicability: Original input 600 pg per reaction. information_effects: Adds Nextera fragment-end adapters while preserving barcode-linked cDNA on the subset of fragments spanning the bead-proximal transcript end.

unresolved.description: Supplemental implementation notes call 50 cells/uL a standard final concentration, and separately specify bead feed 120/uL giving 60/uL in droplets. Figure S3 caption explicitly describes a 50-cells/uL concentration in droplets for its impurity experiment; the culture dilution and retina preparation paragraphs describe their suspension concentrations. These have different sample/experiment anchors, so the record neither declares them contradictory nor silently assigns every reported cell concentration to the same syringe/droplet reference. This does not block the generic equal-aqueous-flow interface.
unresolved.next_evidence: A source-specific clarification mapping the implementation-note standard 50 cells/uL to pre-co-flow suspension versus final droplet concentration, if an execution concentration is required.

unresolved.description: Supplement p8 explicitly states Read1CustSeqA or Read1CustSeqB for priming read 1, and the read-structure description assigns cell barcode/UMI to read 1. The p25 bead note pairs SeqB with Read1CustSeqB but literally says to prime read 2 in that clause, while subsequently recommending SeqB with that primer. This localized wording discrepancy remains unresolved; the record follows the explicit p8 read-1 procedure and preserves matched bead/primer identities. It does not block the general paired barcode/transcript readout or support a second barcode-bearing read.

unresolved.description: The supplement Methods ranks barcodes by total transcripts and cumulative transcripts; Figure S3A caption describes decreasing read counts and cumulative reads. Their reference anchors differ and no equivalence or executed cutoff calculation is established. The record represents the Methods transcript-based empirical rule, preserving the caption difference. No automatic knee detector or exact threshold selection algorithm is supplied; this is nonblocking for a qualified source-described cell-selection boundary, not enough to reproduce exact cell lists.
unresolved.next_evidence: Original barcode-ranking/knee-selection code or author clarification resolving transcript versus read ranking and the cutoff-selection procedure.

unresolved.description: Species-mixing interpretation and the half-of-doublets assumption are explicit, but the inspected general description does not give a universal numeric threshold for designating mixed-species versus organism-specific barcodes. The conditional characterization operation is preserved as source-described scoring with unknown internals, not a complete arbitrary-sample doublet classifier. This does not block general gene molecule counts. Separately, the original retina preparation with a 1 cell/µL (0.5%) HEK spike-in could not calibrate purity/doublets because of retinal cell-size heterogeneity (retained with source evidence in species_mixing_interpretation). That demonstrated applicability limit is known; no numerical threshold resolution is claimed by adding it.
unresolved.next_evidence: Original mixed-species classification criteria/code and assumptions for the selected mixture if reproducing numerical doublet or impurity estimates.
